title: AI Gateway Resilient Fallback, Multi-Tier Token Quota & Cost-Safety Limiter
objective: Harden AI Gateway with offline curriculum fallback mode, tier-based token quotas, sliding-window rate limiting, and zero-crash AI cost-guard enforcement.
in_scope: Harden server/middleware/aiCostGuard.ts or AI gateway for tier-based token quota enforcement.
Ensure graceful fallback to pre-rendered curriculum explanations when Gemini API is rate-limited or offline.
Verify with npx tsc --noEmit and npm run build.
out_of_scope: Modifying core curriculum lattice or prerequisite unlock laws.
acceptance_criteria: AI endpoints reject requests exceeding tier token quotas with HTTP 429 and dignified upgrade messaging.
AI Gateway degrades gracefully to deterministic offline curriculum fallback during upstream outages without 500 errors.
Automated AI cost safety test passes 100% of assertions.
Zero TypeScript errors and clean production build.
risks: Upstream Gemini API network variance (mitigated by timeout locks and cached curriculum fallbacks).
